label: Gallery
description: A photography category — a kicker, an intro, and a masonry grid of images with click-to-enlarge.

metadata.label: Kicker
metadata.description: Small label above the title, e.g. 'Portraits' or 'Iceland, 2024'.

metadata.label: Intro
metadata.description: A short paragraph under the title. Leave empty to skip it.

metadata.label: Columns
metadata.description: Columns on a wide screen. Drops to 2 on tablet, 1 on phone.

metadata.label: Image corners
metadata.description: Corner rounding for every photo on this page, thumbnails and enlarged view alike.

fields.label: Caption
fields.description: Shown under the photo and in the enlarged view.

fields.label: Alt text
fields.description: Description for screen readers. Falls back to the caption.
